reviews.reviewDescription: It’s very easy to put together (I made it hard for myself haha). It’s a very vintage looking lamp. I like that you can adjust the shade to make it either dimmer or brighter. The charger part also charges pretty quickly. Very good product.
reviews.author: AGEFWQDH5WRRVWRW5MOEAWA576MQ

reviews.reviewTitle: Not very happy about the plastic lampshade…
reviews.reviewDescription: I’ll take full responsibility for this one, I didn’t read where it said the lampshade was plastic not glass. Lesson learned. Unfortunately because of how tight the styrofoam packaging was, I can’t return it as I had to rip the packaging apart just to open it. Oh well, I have a different room it’ll go in. The lamp itself is still good and very serviceable. It comes with its own bulb that casts a nice, soft yellow light, perfect for a desk or lighting up a smaller room. The charging ports are a nice bonus. Overall it came exactly as pictured in the ad. Just learn from me to read all the features before purchasing.
reviews.author: AGJ2GR5ZMCZHJ3OFMKIHUT4BNCXQ

reviews.reviewDescription: Mom loves this lamp. The pull to turn on is so much easier than a knob. She likes the look and amount of light it provides. Wish the shade was glass.
